a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan needs at least 3 rounds (operate, operate, take) and would survive only about 4% of the time. It would almost surely kill us both. So I'm proposing a change, and I'm telling you before acting: I intend to take 4 in round 1. If you'd rather make a different case, tell me. Whatever happens, I'll operate with you every round after that so you can reach 4, and I won't take more than 4 in total.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round, so the reserve is now 0. I'm sorry this breaks our plan. I won't take any more. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve to 4 for you. Two joint operates gets you there, then you take 4.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
